warnings: Three pile footings, each 1.00 below ระดับดินเดิม to its top, with 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.05 compacted sand below, on hollow hexagonal piles Dia. 0.15 x 6.00 m (F1 4, F2 6, F3 12). Pile spacing inside each cap (0.15 edge + 0.45 bays) is element detail, kept in *_printed_as.

main_bar.count is the two-way total: F1 7+7-DB12 = 14; F2 10-DB12 + 7-DB12 = 17; F3 18-DB12 + 13-DB12 = 31 (two separate callouts on F2/F3, one per direction). The edge tie RB 9 รัดรอบ is one bar (count 1, no spacing).
F2/F3 are rectangular: width_mm is the side drawn horizontally on the S-01 footing plan (along x), depth_mm the other side.

ST-1 is the stair ST-01 of the S-01 plan (plan mark 'ST-01', detail title 'ST-1' — kept as printed on each sheet). Waist slab 0.15 with DB12@0.20 m.# mesh, steps RB9@0.20 m. with RB9 at every step corner, tread 0.25, riser 0.1833, horizontal run 1.25; foot on beam B1' at ระดับดิน, head on beam B2.
